units.evidence: The newly introduced withSecretandSeed path at 64 bytes proves bidirectionally against the old withSeed result, with both target bodies fully inlined and different. The 200/256-byte paths still contain residual helper calls and are unproved.

units.precondition: XXH_VECTOR=0; 192 writable output bytes; old initCustomSecret vs new generateSecret_fromSeed
units.evidence: Bidirectional Alive2 proves all 192 output bytes for arbitrary seed; 24 further bidirectional word checks cover seed zero against the default secret. Common 256-byte long-hash core IR is byte-identical.
